summary: Fire tower that took the name of a Missaukee County village; a 1939 newspaper item shows it linked by CCC telephone line. No source gives its build date or current state.

events.note: Clare Sentinel item: CCC enrollees from Camp Houghton Lake beginning six miles of telephone line from the Moddersville tower to the main line at the camp

corrections.why: The county is Missaukee. The Weebly source and the brief drop a letter; the 2023 village article spells it correctly.

sources.title: The Shadow Town of Moddersville: Missaukee County, Michigan

notes_for_editor: Only a 1939 Clare Sentinel item (quoted on the Weebly page) places the tower in the record. No build date, design, height, status or access source was found. The Weebly page and the 99 WFMK article are the only tower-specific and village-specific pages read. The brief's status and access are unknown and left unchanged. The 'Conservation Department' is named without the word Michigan in the 1939 text; the agency fact assumes the state department. A search snippet listed a Moddersville Lookout Tower on the anyplaceamerica topo-map directory, which was not fetched (that site returned HTTP 403 to fetch_text). Coordinates in the brief (44.2033, -84.9069) were not checked.
